name: Close Button
summary: Compact native close action that requests dismissal while the containing overlay, toast, drawer, or surface owns state, Escape, motion, removal, and focus restoration.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Decorative close icon rendered inside the named button.

behavior.name: dismissAction
behavior.description: The native button requests dismissal of its owned surface without submitting forms. Escape, open state, exit motion, removal, and focus restoration belong to that containing surface.

behavior.name: motionPreference
behavior.description: Decorative color and background transitions are removed when the user requests reduced motion without changing the dismiss request.

behavior.name: atomicInlineLayout
behavior.description: The fixed-size control participates as an inline flex atom so surrounding layout does not acquire a block-level break.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.description: Contextual accessible action name such as Close dialog or Dismiss alert.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Decorative close indicator hidden from assistive technology.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Temporarily makes the native dismiss action unavailable.

accessibility: Provide a clear accessible name such as Close or Dismiss.
Keep Escape handling, exit motion, removal, and focus management owned by the containing overlay or dismissible surface.
Honor reduced-motion preferences for decorative color and background transitions.
Keep the target at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels.

web.notes: Implemented as a native named inline-flex button with decorative icon slot, native disabled behavior, focus visibility, and reduced-motion CSS in components/css/primitives.css.
